objective: Create memorable original AI singers whose approved vocal and visual references persist across Melodio projects.
productPrinciple: Singer identity remains separate from a song's arrangement, a scene's styling and a channel's editorial brand.

menuRoles.incubator: Create and audition the singer, select a canonical vocal reference and photographic anchor, review identity, then approve.
menuRoles.persona: Manage saved singers, personality, world, musical boundaries, profile revisions and linked works.
menuRoles.voiceLab: Independent exploration, custom timbre design and owned voice registration. References feed artist records without merging the catalogs.

firstRelease.sharedCloudRecord: Owner-scoped signed immutable records in existing melodio-private Storage, stable UUID and compare-and-swap revisions, no destructive migration.
firstRelease.voice: Server-resolved official, discovery, designed or registered reference independent of favorite membership.
firstRelease.language: Only the reference's available sample or registration language is presented as supported; ko/en/ja/fr. Additional languages need separate singing validation.
firstRelease.portrait: Owned photographic reference upload, JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 4MiB, bytes/type/hash/signature checked and normalized to reviewed 1024px square JPEG before approval. The reference remains private.
firstRelease.approval: Voice audition, portrait review and personality/appearance review are explicit. Identity edits return to draft and require renewed approval.
firstRelease.music: Three studios receive artistId and revision. The server resolves the approved identity before any paid metadata or music call and rejects incompatibility instead of dropping the singer.
firstRelease.covers: Artist-mode songs reuse the exact approved portrait through a signed generation snapshot; do not invent another face or dispatch an image-generation request. A/B use the same cover. Cover copies use the existing public artwork bucket.
firstRelease.works: Owner-only bounded gallery tracks artist identity and revision; raw provider metadata is never exposed.
firstRelease.archive: Archive singers without erasing reference history or existing songs.
firstRelease.legacy: Existing browser-only vocal bindings remain untouched; no unreviewed automatic conversion into approved singers.

timbre: No unintended doubled lead or choir
identity: Same reference across three contrasting genres
qualityCriteria.distinctiveness: Different singers should remain distinguishable with names and portraits hidden. More profiles alone do not establish vocal diversity.
qualityCriteria.limits: Manual readiness is creator review, not an automatic acoustic quality or identity score. A style persona is not a promise of a 100% identical cloned singer.

subsequentStages.deliverable: Audition workspace comparing the same singer in three genres, retain original results and creator assessments before wider catalog expansion.
Generate new photographic scenes with actual reference-image inputs. Add approval workflow for front/side/full-body anchors and compare identity; no prompt-only face-preservation claim.
Persona architect interviews compile editable structured traits, lyrical perspective, behavior and musical boundaries into the same artist profile.
Artist-linked video performance, releases and channel publishing with explicit external-connection status. IP registration claims require a real implementation.

releasePolicy: Validate repository ownership, conflict handling, canonical voice resolution, studio compatibility and cover signature before deployment. Do not spend generation credits just to demonstrate a CRUD deployment.
